questions.text: Adverse selection occurs when
options: A person takes more risks that are not known to the life insurance company because he has life insurance
A person buys life insurance because he has risky lifestyle that is not known to the life insurance company
A person is a risk lover
Pregnant women with health insurance make more doctor visits than uninsured pregnant women
questions.correct_answer: A person buys life insurance because he has risky lifestyle that is not known to the life insurance company

questions.text: Moral hazard occurs when contracts are written in such a way that
options: The interests of agent and principal conve
The interests of agent and principal diverge
Agents will wish to maximize the principal’s utility
Production and risk bearing efficiency are achieved
questions.correct_answer: The interests of agent and principal diverge

questions.text: Which of the following best describes the free rider problem?
options: When individuals contribute more than their fair share to a public good
When individuals benefit from public good without contributing to its cost
When firms charge excessively high prices for public goods
When governments provide too many private goods.
questions.correct_answer: When individuals benefit from public good without contributing to its cost
